hook: Every request the system takes moves through three separate stages before anything reaches you.

sections.voiceover: The system processes every request through three separate stages, and a failure at any one of them stops the whole line.
On the dashboard, the operator submits the query and the platform returns a ranked list of results within seconds.
Throughput collapsed because the second stage was holding every batch until the slowest item finished.
The line ran this way from 1998 until 2015, when the batching rule was finally removed.
